summary: Europa Report is a 2013 science fiction found footage film directed by Sebastián Cordero. It depicts the fictional first crewed mission to Europa, one of Jupiter's four Galilean moons. After a technical failure cuts all communication with Earth mission control, the crew continues toward Europa and finds mounting evidence of life there.
one_line: A 2013 found footage science fiction film about a fictional first crewed mission to Jupiter's moon Europa, which finds evidence of life.
key_facts: Europa Report is a 2013 science fiction film directed by Sebastián Cordero.
The film stars Christian Camargo, Anamaria Marinca, Michael Nyqvist, Daniel Wu, Karolina Wydra and Sharlto Copley.
Europa Report is a found footage film.
The film recounts the fictional story of the first crewed mission to Europa.
Europa is one of the four Galilean moons of Jupiter.
A disastrous technical failure causes the loss of all communications between the Europa mission crew and Earth mission control.
Despite the technical failure and a series of crises, the crew continues its mission to Europa.
The crew in Europa Report finds mounting evidence of life on the moon Europa.
